rules.applies_to: M-1 buildings or portions of buildings abutting AG-2 or AG-5 and exceeding 30 feet in height.

params.name: additional_setback_rate_per_height
params.unit: feet of setback per foot of building height
params.condition: Applies only to buildings or portions of buildings abutting a lot in the AG-2 or AG-5 zoning district; measured from the required landscape buffer as required in 21A.48.080
params.quote: Additional Setback When Abutting AG-2 And AG-5 Districts: When abutting a lot in the AG-2 or AG-5 Zoning District, buildings or portions of buildings, shall be set back one foot (1') beyond the required landscape buffer as required in section 21A.48.080 of this title for every one foot (1') of building height above thirty feet (30').

params.name: height_threshold_for_additional_setback
params.condition: Additional setback accrues only on height above 30 feet (1 foot of setback for every 1 foot of building height above 30 feet)
params.quote: Additional Setback When Abutting AG-2 And AG-5 Districts: When abutting a lot in the AG-2 or AG-5 Zoning District, buildings or portions of buildings, shall be set back one foot (1') beyond the required landscape buffer as required in section 21A.48.080 of this title for every one foot (1') of building height above thirty feet (30').

rules.applies_to: Buildings in M-1, subject to the listed structure, location, overlay, and FAA exceptions.

params.name: max_building_height_base
params.condition: Base maximum; exceptions apply
params.quote: No building shall exceed sixty five feet (65') except that emission free distillation column structures, necessary for manufacture processing purposes, shall be permitted up to the most restrictive Federal Aviation Administration imposed minimal approach surface elevations, or one hundred twenty feet (120') maximum, whichever is less.

params.name: exception_distillation_column_height_max
params.condition: Emission-free distillation column structures necessary for manufacture processing purposes permitted up to the most restrictive FAA-imposed minimal approach surface elevations, or 120 feet maximum, whichever is less
params.quote: No building shall exceed sixty five feet (65') except that emission free distillation column structures, necessary for manufacture processing purposes, shall be permitted up to the most restrictive Federal Aviation Administration imposed minimal approach surface elevations, or one hundred twenty feet (120') maximum, whichever is less.

rules.rule_name: Height exception: west of airport / north of I-80
rules.applies_to: M-1 buildings west of Salt Lake City International Airport and north of I-80.

params.name: max_building_height_exception_zone
params.condition: M-1 buildings west of Salt Lake City International Airport and north of I-80; conditional on design review standards and procedures of chapter 21A.59
params.quote: West of the Salt Lake City International Airport and north of Interstate 80 (I-80): Buildings may exceed sixty-five feet (65') in height subject to the design review standards and procedures of chapter 21A.59 of this title. In no case shall any building exceed eighty-five feet (85').

rules.applies_to: Required front and corner side yards in M-1; buffer requirement applies where an M-1 lot abuts a residential district.

params.name: landscape_yard_requirement
params.condition: All required front and corner side yards maintained as landscape yards in conformance with Chapter 21A.48; all lots abutting a lot in a residential district conform to landscape buffer yard requirements of Chapter 21A.48. Qualitative — no numeric value in quote.
params.quote: Front And Corner Side Yards: All required front and corner side yards shall be maintained as landscape yards in conformance with the requirements of chapter 21A.48 of this title. Landscape Buffer Yards: All lots abutting a lot in a residential district shall conform to the landscape buffer yard requirements of chapter 21A.48 of this title.

rules.rule_name: Maximum building height (tiered by lot size)
rules.applies_to: Buildings in OS; standards branch by lot area, height, design review, and the public-utilities critical-infrastructure exemption.

params.name: lot_size_tier_threshold
params.condition: Boundary between the two height tiers: lots 4 acres or less vs lots greater than 4 acres
params.quote: Lots four (4) acres or less: Building height shall be limited to thirty five (35) feet; provided that for each foot of height in excess of twenty (20) feet, each required yard and landscaped yard shall be increased one foot. Lots greater than four (4) acres: Building heights in excess of thirty five (35) feet but not more than forty five (45) feet may be permitted provided, that for each foot of height over thirty five (35) feet, each required yard and landscaped yard shall be increased one foot. Building heights in excess of forty five (45) feet up to sixty (60) feet may be approved through the design review process and that for each foot of height over thirty five (35) feet, each required yard and landscaped yard shall be increased one (1) foot. Heights for buildings or structures for the Salt Lake City Public Utilities Department that are not specifically exempt in section 21A.02.050 of this title, are exempt from the height restrictions in this zoning district provided the building or structure is deemed by the director of the public utilities department as critical infrastructure necessary to provide specific utility needs to the public.

gaps.name: abutting_district_greater_height_value
gaps.detail: gap: for the listed civic uses, when abutting a district allowing greater height, the abutting district's standard applies — that numeric value is not stated in the PL-02 quote and must be looked up per adjacent district

notes: All values are transcribed from the verbatim stored quotes (values and quotes stored together in verified_rules.json); units preserved as stated. M-1-01 min lot area 10,000 sqft / 80 ft width reflects the current codified text (Ord. 47A25, 2025); older 20,000 sqft figures in legacy documents are superseded per the stored ambiguity_note. OS-02/OS-04 must be consumed jointly: OS-04 base yards branch at 4 acres and OS-02 yard-inflation applies whenever height exceeds the tier thresholds. PL-01/PL-02/PL-03 all branch on use (public schools vs listed civic/entertainment uses vs other permitted uses); a screener must resolve the use before applying params. M-1-06 and OS-05 are qualitative (Chapter 21A.48 landscaping conformance) with no machine-readable numeric parameter — recorded as gaps, not zeros. M-1-02 (M-1 base yard minimums: front 15, corner side 15, interior none, rear none) and PL-04 (landscape buffer) were outside the requested rule list and are not in this package.
